about: Machine-checkable replacement for the prose audit in docs/fact-check.md (Plan 6, Task 4a). Every row names the content line it backs and a verification of exactly one kind: fetched (a URL plus words scripts/fact-check.mjs re-opens and confirms — a 403, a timeout or a vanished quote is a FAILURE), cited (a real source with no fetchable URL, plus the exact or best-available quoted words and where they appear — the script can only confirm the row is complete, not that the words are true), or derived (recomputed from this repo's own data: src/data/geo.json's neighbour lists and path geometry, or the content files' own line ids). docs/fact-check.md keeps the narrative history of what was wrong and why; this file is what the gate actually runs.
excludedFromDocMd: Three rows in docs/fact-check.md are marked "(not stated)" — claims that were considered and rejected before ever reaching the narration (odisha.jagannath.line's top-pot claim, kerala.intro's coconut etymology, kerala.chinese-nets.line's Chinese-origin claim). They assert nothing the child hears, so there is nothing here to verify; they remain documented only in docs/fact-check.md.
verbatimNote: cited.verbatim is true only where docs/fact-check.md (or the source itself) recorded the source's own words in quotation marks. Where the original prose audit only ever recorded a paraphrase or a bare figure, verbatim is false — that gap is real and is reported by scripts/fact-check.mjs, not hidden by inventing a quotation mark.
